description: Test suite for gateway process argument parsing functions, including parseProcCmdline, parseWindowsCmdline, and isGatewayArgv, verifying their behavior with various input scenarios.

methods.name: parseProcCmdline
methods.description: Parses a null-delimited command line string into an array of arguments.

methods.name: parseWindowsCmdline
methods.description: Parses a Windows command line string into an array of arguments, handling quotes and whitespace.

methods.name: isGatewayArgv
methods.description: Determines if a given argument array indicates a gateway process invocation, based on known entrypoints and executable names.
